Continuing our series on Bills of the Current Session, these next three Bills are at First Stage, the point where a Bill is formally introduced in the Oireachtas. This is usually the beginning of the parliamentary process, with detailed debate on the Bill’s general principles normally taking place at Second Stage.

• Criminal Law (Adult Safeguarding) Bill 2026
• Defence (Amendment) Bill 2026
• Railway Safety Bill 2026
